coordinate_convention: point=[x,y] indexes the unchanged full source PNG at integer pixels; no atlas/crop/padding offset has been applied.
method: Original sheets were visually inspected. Interior hair, iris and garment points were chosen manually, raw RGB values read with Pillow, and the exact specified integer reader key predicates evaluated independently. Expected values are reader fixture expectations, not a claim that the game reader or rendered screen was already tested.
expected_reader_behavior: Keyed source pixels receive alpha 0. All other source pixels retain exact RGB with alpha 255. The reader adds one transparent pixel around each crop; fixture source-point mapping must account for that padding separately. Global shader appearance is not tested here.
boundary_scope: Background-colored edge pixels are not included as interior evidence. A color-only reader cannot distinguish a genuine outline pixel whose RGB matches the key from background. Such boundary ambiguity is not classified as proved interior color loss, and this sampling is not exhaustive proof for every artwork pixel.
